title: Identity unit for the specified common-stage compositor
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D and a geometric space T over D [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data], with l invertible at each residue field. There exists e:commonStageDerivedPullback(l,Qbar_l,id_T)≅Id. For every common-stage constructible object M, the hom of pullbackTensorCommonComposition(l,Qbar_l,id_T,id_T,M), followed by e at the identity-pullback object, is heterogeneously equal to that object identity. The pullback functor and compositor are the specified maps of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [def-pod-rational-common-pullback-composition]; no new compositor is chosen.

proof.text: Residue-field invertibility gives stalk units through the local residue homomorphism. Apply isomorphismFieldTransportFiniteStage at every finite coefficient field to the identity morphism; its rationalEquivalence field makes each rational identity pullback full and faithful. No inequality l != p and no nonemptiness assumption is used.

Use commonStagePullbackNormalizedDescent to identify the actual common-stage identity pullback F with the functor of its normalized stage-system morphism G. On a representative a at stage n, its action is beta_P followed by Phi_n(a) followed by beta_Q inverse. Fullness follows by applying the full functor Phi_n to the preimage of beta_P inverse followed by a followed by beta_Q. For faithfulness put two source arrows at one common stage; an equality of their images has a further-stage witness. The identity tr(mapAt(a)) = mapAt(tr(a)) and cancellation of the two beta isomorphisms reduce that equality to one reflected by the faithful functor at the larger stage. The resulting witness proves equality of the original quotient arrows.

Specialize common_compositor_existsUnique from PodCoefficientDescent to the twice-identity pair. The equality-only copyObj functors in that statement equal their originals by the existing proved private commonPullback_eq helper (Functor.ext_of_iso and the recorded object equalities). Transport the natural isomorphism along these equalities and id composed with id = id, retaining the component HEq by equality induction. This gives a natural isomorphism c:F -> F composed with F whose components are heterogeneously equal to the specified pullbackTensorCommonComposition components; no compositor is replaced.

Apply Mathlib Functor.fullyFaithfulCancelRight to c inverse, with the identity left unitor, to obtain e:F -> Id. Its component formula and map_preimage give F(e_M)=c_M inverse. Naturality of e at e_M says F(e_M) followed by e_M equals e_(FM) followed by e_M. Cancel the invertible right factor to obtain e_(FM)=F(e_M). Consequently c_M followed by e_(FM) equals c_M followed by c_M inverse, hence the identity. Substitute the specified component HEq to finish.

theorem exists_common_pullback_identity_unit (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (T : GeometricSpace D)
    [∀ x : T.base.left, Invertible (l : T.base.left.residueField x)] :
    ∃ e : commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left) ≅ 𝟭 _,
    ∀ M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) T.base.left,
      HEq
        ((pullbackTensorCommonComposition l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left) (𝟙 T.base.left) M).hom ≫
          e.hom.app ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left)).obj M))
        (𝟙 ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) (𝟙 T.base.left)).obj M))
